feature_name: PostgreSQL Data Sync Wildcard Address Restriction
description: Implement a security enhancement that prevents the use of wildcard IP addresses (0.0.0.0 and ::) in PostgreSQL data sync configurations. This feature should validate and reject these addresses during data sync setup to ensure connections are made to specific, non-wildcard endpoints.
functional_requirements: Add validation logic to reject IPv4 wildcard address (0.0.0.0) when configuring PostgreSQL data sync connections
Add validation logic to reject IPv6 wildcard address (::) when configuring PostgreSQL data sync connections
Provide clear error messages explaining why wildcard addresses are not permitted for security reasons
Ensure the validation occurs both during initial configuration and any subsequent updates to data sync settings
Update existing tests to verify the new validation behavior works correctly
Maintain backward compatibility by not affecting existing valid configurations that don't use wildcard addresses
